pages.title: Load and Seal
pages.text: Use materials and compatible fluid containers on an open barrel; BucketLib Wooden and Ceramic Buckets are supported. A bucket adds 1000 mB; a plain Water Bottle adds 250 mB. Empty-hand use collects output first, otherwise toggles the lid. Sneak-empty-hand use retrieves input first. Sealing blocks loading and transfer.

pages.title: Processing
pages.text: Load the required input count and fluid, then seal for sealed recipes. The recipe timer needs its conditions satisfied. Input and output fluid stores remain separate but share 4000 mB total capacity, preventing produced tannin from mixing with fresh water.

pages.title: Drain and Reuse
pages.text: Use an empty compatible container to drain output fluid first, then input when output is empty. Containers keep their own fluid restrictions; Firstworks clay buckets hold only water/tannin. Manual container use works from any face. Drain produced fluid to free capacity before adding more water. Open exposed barrels can collect rainwater. A rising redstone pulse toggles the lid once, rather than repeatedly toggling while powered.

pages.title: Faces and Wood
pages.text: Top faces accept inputs, bottom faces extract outputs, and sides allow both. A sealed lid locks transfers. Oak, spruce, birch, jungle, acacia, dark oak, mangrove, cherry, bamboo, crimson, and warped barrels share these mechanics; packs can add wood families.
